content.comment_body: Hello, I have a project where I need to make certain points accessible to a customer. To start, I configured modbus points on two separate [product_name] devices to test communication. These were set up as modbus-compatible devices to replicate my intended real-world scenario. I set up one device as a server with a client connection and the second device as a client with a server connection. I also added a simple digital input to the network output. Currently, I am unable to get these two [product_name] devices to communicate. Any assistance would be appreciated.
I only see one [product_name] diagram provided, not two.
Attached is a network project example showing two [product_name] devices connected via Modbus.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are working to set up Modbus TCP communication between two [product_name] devices, configuring server/client and client/server roles. They are experiencing challenges getting the devices to communicate and have limited troubleshooting feedback from the system. There is a clear need for more detailed guidance, diagnostics, or tools to validate configurations and identify any issues.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward, reliable Modbus TCP communication between two [product_name] devices after server/client and client/server setup, with an easy configuration process and immediate data exchange.
